releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.91 moves Price Book into its own persistent bottom tab immediately before Settings. The old Settings Tools entry for Price Book and Barcode Scanner is removed; barcode scanning remains directly inside Price Book search. Price Book now uses circular product thumbnails and places a larger colorful category-management folder button beside the search field, while preserving products, prices, categories, subcategories, barcodes, guides and local data.
